newsitem.title: UK: LME copper holds gains in late London.
newsitem.headline: LME copper holds gains in late London.

text.p: London Metal Exchange (LME) three-months copper was little changed from the kerb close during late inter-office activity on Monday.
LME base metal prices had climbed away from earlier lows during Monday afternoon trading, although activity was subdued and volume thin.
Copper's mini-rally saw it push away from under $2,250 per tonne to close the kerb still $15 easier but at $2,257. It was bid at $2,260 at 1800 Gmt when Comex closed.
Aluminium shaved its losses as well. It still closed the kerb down $15 at $1,549. It was bid at $1,549 at 1800 GMT.
Brokerage Rudolf Wolff said in its Evening Metal Report that the afternoon turnaround was "perhaps an indication that the funds are losing their appetite for the downside..."
